subject: MedSynergy MAP handoff + kickoff / onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsynergy.com>, Tom Wilkes <tom.wilkes@medsynergy.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MedSynergy MAP handoff + kickoff / onboarding timeline

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're excited to get the MAP (mutual action plan) moving so your team can start evaluation and go-live on the timeline we discussed. Attached is the initial MAP (MedSynergy_MAP_v1.pdf) and a copy of the signed SOW for reference (MedSynergy_SOW_signed.pdf).

High level proposal:
- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff call — introductions, roles, success criteria
- Weeks 1–3: evaluation & integrations (API keys, sandbox access, sample data checks)
- Weeks 4–6: pilot/validation with your sample flows; quality checkpoints
- Week 8: production cutover (tentative)

Proposed times for a 30–45 min kickoff: Thu Jul 30 at 10:00am PT or Fri Jul 31 at 9:00am PT. Please let us know which works — happy to accommodate other times.

Role notes:
- Redwood owner: Lauren Bishop (Customer Success) — will run onboarding and post-sign handoffs
- Redwood technical lead (sandbox/API): Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer)
- MedSynergy exec sponsor: Samira Khan
- MedSynergy technical lead: Tom Wilkes

Immediate asks for kickoff:
1) Confirm kickoff time
2) Share list of 2–3 evaluation use cases + sample data contact
3) Confirm any compliance checkpoints (SOC2 / data residency) you want to prioritize during evaluation

Thanks — I’ll hand this over to Lauren to coordinate the operational plan once we lock a time.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0246

Attachments: MedSynergy_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP), MedSynergy_SOW_signed.pdf (SOW)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsynergy.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wilkes <tom.wilkes@medsynergy.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedSynergy MAP handoff + kickoff / onboarding timeline

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the summary and the MAP. Both Thu 7/30 10:00am PT and Fri 7/31 9:00am PT look possible for us; Thu 10:00am PT would be my preference.

A few quick items from our side:
- I'll be the exec sponsor but Tom (copied) will lead day-to-day coordination and technical validation.
- For evaluation use cases we want: 1) intake form triage -> suggested reply, 2) clinical note summarization for clinician review, 3) search/semantic matching for prior similar cases.
- Sample data: Tom will share an SFTP account and a contact for the data team (he’ll email after this).
- Compliance: SOC2 is a must; we may need additional documentation around data retention and audit logs before pilot.

Confirming Thu 7/30 10:00am PT for kickoff. Please send an invite with a short agenda.

Regards,
Samira Khan
VP Product, MedSynergy Health
samira.khan@medsynergy.com | +1 650-555-1133

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsynergy.com>, Tom Wilkes <tom.wilkes@medsynergy.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedSynergy MAP handoff + kickoff / onboarding timeline

Thanks team — locking in 7/30 10:00am PT for the kickoff. Sending the calendar invite now.

Quick internal notes / handoff plan (high priority items I’ll lead):
- Owner: Lauren Bishop (CS Lead) — overall onboarding owner and SLA escalation contact
- Technical onboarding: Monica Patel to provision sandbox, generate API keys, and run initial integration checks (Monica will schedule a separate runbook session with Tom within 3 business days of kickoff)
- MAP tracking: I’ll create the MAP tracker in our onboarding project (ONB-88) and add milestones / owners per item
- Evaluation success criteria (to confirm on call):
  * Triage accuracy: >= 85% on holdout set
  * Summarization: average clinician rating >= 4/5 on sample reviews
  * Latency: 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for the pilot flows
- Compliance gating: I’ll pull SOC2 artifacts and retention policy docs for the kickoff; Monica and I will meet with your security contact if needed next week

Action items before kickoff (Lauren / Monica / Sergio):
1) Lauren: create MAP tracker + add attendees (by 7/29 EOD)
2) Monica: prepare sandbox credentials and a short integration checklist (by 7/31)
3) Sergio: confirm contract/admin contacts and set HubSpot deal stage to "Onboarding"

Looking forward to running this — Monica, please confirm when the sandbox is ready so I can put Tom on the integration slot.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0178

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsynergy.com>, Tom Wilkes <tom.wilkes@medsynergy.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedSynergy MAP handoff + kickoff / onboarding timeline

Perfect — thanks Lauren and Samira. Invite sent for Thu 7/30 10:00am PT (Google Meet link in the invite).

Summary of agreed next steps (posting here so it’s easy to track):
- Kickoff: Thu 7/30 10:00am PT — intro, confirm success criteria, compliance checklist
- MAP owner (Redwood): Lauren Bishop — will own the tracker and milestone follow-ups (ONB-88)
- Technical lead (Redwood): Monica Patel — sandbox + API keys, integration runbook
- Customer contacts: Samira (exec sponsor), Tom (technical lead)
- Pre-kickoff deliverables: MedSynergy to send sample data SFTP details; Redwood to surface SOC2 artifacts and MAP tracker link

I’ve added the HubSpot deal link and onboarding ticket to the calendar invite. If anything else pops up, flag here and we’ll adjust.

See you all on Thu.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
